newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Palestinian President Arafat to visit Ireland.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian President Arafat to visit Ireland.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat will visit Ireland on October 29 and 30, a spokesman for the Palestinian Liberation Organisation (PLO) said on Wednesday.
The spokesman said Arafat would meet Ireland's prime minister, foreign minister and president during the two-day visit.
A spokeswoman for Ireland's Department of Foreign Affairs confirmed that Arafat would be visiting the country but said the details of his visit had not been finalised.
Ireland is currently president of the European Union and Irish Foreign Minister Dick Spring travelled to Israel and Gaza earlier this month to lend the EU's support to the Middle East peace process.
